title: What if
caption: Hari wondered what chasing slow customers would do to his score before he started. The founder tells his story.
linkedin_text: In ScoreMyBiz, once an owner has a score, he can nudge revenue, expenses and how fast customers pay by a few percent and see how the score would move. It is a what-if on his own numbers, not a forecast.

cast.hari: Hari, a young Indian grocery shop owner with a trimmed beard, in a green polo shirt with a small notebook in his hand

scenes.clip: the founder, a young Indian man with a short beard in a navy suit and striped tie, facing the camera in a neat grocery shop with shelves of packaged goods behind him, a warm smile.
scenes.vo: Hi. This is Hari's story. Some customers pay him late, and he wondered what chasing them would change.
